areas.t: A slow-moving high-pressure system just offshore will help keep conditions mild and dry through midweek before transitioning to more unsettled weather and possible rain leading into the weekend. High temperatures on Monday and Tuesday will be in the upper 60s along the coast and 70-80 degrees inland
